title: Primitives: buttons, input, filter toggles and badges
goal: Buttons, the LLM input, the filter checkboxes and state labels use bricks primitives
acceptance: Action-bar, vision and LLM buttons use the bricks button; the LLM input uses input; filters use toggle or tag; state labels use badge
No local override of a bricks component; specs pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: five templates, about ten controls, utility classes removed. Not a measurement.
